Button.description: The skinnable plugin button used in the plugin interface (used for visual plugins with their own window only, i.e. isVisual == true and isInsideMode == false).

isViewer.description: Defines if the button is shown in the viewer mode only or not.

primary.description: Defines if the button is primary or not. The primary flag affects the button skin only.

text.description: The label which is displayed on the button.

textLocale.description: Translations for the text field. The object keys are the two letter language codes (ru, de, it, etc.) and the values are the button label translation for each language.

Replies.description: An array containing the comment replies represented as the *CommentData* object.

Time.description: The time when the comment was posted (in milliseconds).

UserId.description: The user ID of the comment author.

data.description: The item data (this data will be sent to the click event callback).

disabled.description: Specifies if the current item is disabled or not.

icons.description: The item icons (see the plugins {@link https://api.onlyoffice.com/docs/plugins/configuration/configuration config} documentation).

items.description: An array containing the context menu items for the current item.

separator.description: Specifies if a separator is drawn above the current item.

EditorRestrictions.description:
The current editing restrictions, a combination of the flags:
**0x00** - no editing restrictions,
**0x01** - allows editing form fields,
**0x02** - allows editing comments and regions delimited by range permissions,
**0x04** - the document is signed and cannot be changed,
**0x80** - does not allow editing.

FloatActionButton.description: The floating action button displayed over the editor area.

data.description: The button data (this data will be sent to the click event callback).

disabled.description: Specifies if the current button is disabled or not.

enableToggle.description: Specifies if a button toggle is enabled or not.

icons.description: The button icons, 28x28 px (see the plugins {@link https://api.onlyoffice.com/docs/plugin-and-macros/structure/configuration/ config} documentation).

removed.description: Specifies if the button must be removed from the editor area.

visible.description: Specifies if the current button is visible or not.

FloatActionButtonsMainItem.description: The main floating action button item.

items.description: An array containing the floating action buttons for the plugin.

FontInfo.description: An object containing the font information.

m_aPanose.description: The PANOSE Typeface Classification Number, a compact 10-byte description of the font critical visual characteristics, such as contrast, weight, and serif style.

m_bBold.description: Specifies if the font characters are bold or not.

m_bIsFixed.description: Specifies if the current font is monospaced or not.

m_bItalic.description: Specifies if the font characters are italic or not.

m_eFontFormat.description: The specific file type(s) used to store font data: **0** - *.fon, **1** - *.ttf, **2** - *.ttf, *.otf (CFF), **3** - unknown font format.

m_lIndex.description: The font number in the file if there is more than one font in the file.

m_sFamilyClass.description: The font family class which values are assigned by IBM to each font family.

m_shAscent.description: The height above the baseline for a clipping region.

m_shAvgCharWidth.description: The arithmetic average of the escapement (width) of all non-zero width glyphs in the font.

m_shCapHeight.description: The distance between the baseline and the approximate height of uppercase letters measured in FUnits.

m_shDescent.description: The vertical extent below the baseline for a clipping region.

m_shLineGap.description: The typographic line gap for the current font.

m_shXHeight.description: The distance between the baseline and the approximate height of non-ascending lowercase letters measured in FUnits.

m_ulCodePageRange1.description: The code pages encompassed by the font file (Bits 0-31).

m_ulCodePageRange2.description: The code pages encompassed by the font file (Bits 32-63).

m_ulUnicodeRange1.description: The Unicode range encompassed by the font file (Bits 0-31).

m_ulUnicodeRange2.description: The Unicode range encompassed by the font file (Bits 32-63).

m_ulUnicodeRange3.description: The Unicode range encompassed by the font file (Bits 64-95).

m_ulUnicodeRange4.description: The Unicode range encompassed by the font file (Bits 96-127).

m_usWeigth.description: The visual weight (stroke blackness or thickness) of the font characters (1-1000).

m_usWidth.description: The relative change from the normal aspect ratio (width to height ratio).

m_wsFontPath.description: The path to the file with the current font.

ImageData.description: An object containing the information about the base64 encoded *png* image.

replaceMode.description: Specifies how to adjust the image object in case of replacing the selected image.

src.description: The image source in the base64 format.

Macros.description: An object containing the data about all the macros from the document.

guid.description: An identifier of the plugin which can edit the current OLE object and must be of the *asc.{UUID}* type.

height.description: The OLE object height measured in millimeters.

heightPix.description: The OLE object image height in pixels.

imgSrc.description: A link to the image (its visual representation) stored in the OLE object and used by the plugin.

objectId.description: The internal ID of the OLE object to change. Required by EditOleObject, which does nothing without it; when the plugin was opened on the object, it is `Asc.plugin.info.objectId`.

width.description: The OLE object width measured in millimeters.

widthPix.description: The OLE object image width in pixels.

canRemoved.description: Specifies if the plugin can be removed (**true**) or not (**false**).

guid.description: The plugin identifier. It must be of the *asc.{UUID}* type.

obj.description: The {@link https://api.onlyoffice.com/docs/plugins/configuration/configuration config} of the installed plugin. The version is taken from the config and compared with the current one to check for updates.

all.description: The parameters which will be set for all plugins ({ "all" : { key, value } }).

plugin_guid.description: The parameters which will be set for a specific plugin. The plugin must be specified with the plugin GUID of the asc.{UUID} type ({ "plugin_guid" : { keyForSpecificPlugin : valueForSpecificPlugin } }).

Rect.description:
Axis-aligned rectangle represented as a tuple.

Invariants:

- `rect[0] < rect[2]` (x1 < x2)
- `rect[1] < rect[3]` (y1 < y2)

ReplaceHtmlOptions.description: Options to replace the HTML page content.

separateParagraphs.description: Specifies whether each paragraph will be created in a separate shape.

ReplaceImageMode.description: Specifies how to adjust the image object in case of replacing the selected image.

ReplaceXmlOptions.description: Options to replace the XML page content.

content.description: An array with XML shapes to be replaced.

ShapeType.description: This type specifies the preset shape geometry that will be used for a shape.

disabled.description: Specifies if the current item is disabled or not.

enableToggle.description: Specifies if an item toggle is enabled or not.

icons.description: The item icons (see the plugins {@link https://api.onlyoffice.com/docs/plugins/configuration/configuration config} documentation).

items.description: An array containing the context menu items for the current item.

lockInViewMode.description: Specifies if the current item is locked in the view mode or not.

separator.description: Specifies if a separator is used between the toolbar menu items or not.

split.description: Specifies if the toolbar menu items are split or not.

ToolbarMenuItemType.description: The possible values of the base which the relative vertical position of the toolbar menu item will be calculated from.

tabs.description: An array containing the toolbar menu tabs for the current item.

items.description: An array containing the toolbar menu items for the current tab.
An array containing the window header items.

windowID.description: The plugin child window ID. When omitted, the items are placed on the plugin's main frame header.

align.description: The item alignment in the window header.

disabled.description: Specifies if the current item is disabled or not.

enableToggle.description: Specifies if an item toggle is enabled or not.

icons.description: The item icons (see the plugins {@link https://api.onlyoffice.com/docs/plugin-and-macros/structure/configuration/ config} documentation).

isTitle.description: Specifies if the item replaces the window title or not.

items.description: An array containing the dropdown menu items for the current header item.

removed.description: Specifies if the item must be removed from the header.

split.description: Specifies if the button is split (button + dropdown arrow) or not.

Data.description: An object which contains the comment data.

editorType.description:
The editors which the plugin is available for:

- **word** - text document editor,
- **cell** - spreadsheet editor,
- **slide** - presentation editor,
- **pdf** - pdf editor.

fillForms.description: An object containing the form properties.

tags.description: The form tags which specify the content for each form type with such a tag.
tags.type: { text: string; checkBox: string; picture: string; comboBox: string }

initDataType.description:
The data type selected in the editor and sent to the plugin:

- **text** - the text data,
- **html** - HTML formatted code,
- **ole** - OLE object data,
- **desktop** - the desktop editor data,
- **desktop-external** - the main page data of the desktop app (system messages),
- **none** - no data will be send to the plugin from the editor,
- **sign** - the sign for the keychain plugin.

watermark_on_draw.description: An object containing the watermark properties.

align.description: The vertical text align in the watermark shape: **0** - bottom, **1** - center, **4** - top. The default value is **1**.

fill.description: The watermark fill color in the RGB format, or the URL to image (base64 support: data:image/png;...). The empty array [] means that the watermark has no fill.

height.description: The watermark height measured in millimeters.

margins.description: The text margins measured in millimeters in the watermark shape, in the order: left, top, right, bottom. Applies only when all four values are specified.

paragraphs.description: The array with paragraphs from the current watermark with their properties.
paragraphs.type: { align: number; fill: number[]; linespacing: number; runs: object[] }

rotate.description: The watermark rotation angle measured in degrees.

stroke.description: The watermark stroke color in the RGB format. The empty array [] means that the watermark has no stroke. If only **stroke-width** is specified, the stroke is black.

stroke-width.description: The watermark stroke width measured in millimeters. If only **stroke** is specified, the width is **0.35** mm (1 pt).

transparent.description: The watermark opacity, from **0** (invisible) to **1** (opaque). The default value is **0.3**.

type.description: The type which specifies the preset shape geometry for the current watermark. The default value is **rect**.

width.description: The watermark width measured in millimeters.
